ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of the Feeding Our Future Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and connections between the individuals involved in the Feeding Our Future scheme to uncover the full extent of the fraud.
questions: Who else is involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud operation and hold those responsible accountable. I recommend starting with the financial transactions and working backwards to identify all individuals involved.
